about: A command line tool that makes working with many Git branches easier.

prs.title: Undo no longer deletes a branch with new work on it
prs.broken: Undo deleted the branches the last command made, even if someone had added new commits to them since. Those commits were lost.
prs.changed: Undo now checks for new commits first, says which branches changed and stops. A force option undoes anyway.
prs.matters: Undo can't throw away work by surprise.
